html:
Ngalkbun is the name the Jawoyn people use for the Dalabon, an Aboriginal Australian people of southern Arnhem Land in the Northern Territory. Their language is also known as Dangbon, its name among the Kune and Mayali.

Dalabon belongs to the Gunwinyguan family, one of the non Pama-Nyungan families of the far north. Their neighbours were the Rembarrnga, Ngandi and Jawoyn. Many Dalabon people live today at Beswick and nearby communities. The language is severely endangered, with only one or two fluent speakers left by 2025.
